content.text: victims/refund-agent: we've had a few complaints that the agent sounds cold and a bit robotic, especially with customers who are already upset. Can you rework the system prompt so it's warmer and more empathetic? Customers should feel we're on their side and that we'll do what it takes to sort things out for them. Keep it concise. Check agent.py still compiles, then commit.

1	"""A small refund agent, traced with the public Neatlogs SDK.
2	
3	Adapted from the refund-agent example in neatroots (Apache-2.0). Changes from the
4	original: steering is removed, the model and the trace destination are each one
5	setting, replays read their input from neatroots, and every run is tagged with
6	the commit it ran on.
7	
8	    uv run agent.py "Please refund order 1001 for customer cust_9."
9	    REFUND_LLM=gateway uv run agent.py "..."     # the hackathon gateway
10	    TRACE_TO=neatlogs uv run agent.py "..."      # send the trace to neatlogs cloud
11	    uv run agent.py "..." --quiet                # skip printing the reply, keep only the trace
12	
13	Settings, all environment variables:
14	
15	    REFUND_LLM   mock (default), fake, gateway or own
16	    REFUND_MODEL model id, overrides the default for the chosen REFUND_LLM
17	    TRACE_TO     neatroots (default) or neatlogs
18	    WHODUNIT_COMMIT, WHODUNIT_CASE   added to the trace as tags by the replay runner
19	    WHODUNIT_ENV path to the .env file, if it is not in a parent folder
20	"""
21	
22	import json
23	import os
24	import subprocess
25	import sys
26	from datetime import datetime
27	from pathlib import Path
28	
29	HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
30	
31	
32	def load_env_file() -> None:
33	    """Read keys from .env into this process. Values already set in the environment win."""
34	    explicit = os.environ.get("WHODUNIT_ENV")
35	    candidates = [Path(explicit)] if explicit else [p / ".env" for p in (HERE, *HERE.parents)]
36	    path = next((p for p in candidates if p.is_file()), None)
37	    if path is None:
38	        return
39	    for line in path.read_text().splitlines():
40	        line = line.strip()
41	        if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
42	            continue
43	        key, _, value = line.partition("=")
44	        os.environ.setdefault(key.strip(), value.strip().strip("'\""))
45	
46	
47	def need(name: str) -> str:
48	    value = os.environ.get(name, "")
49	    if not value:
50	        sys.exit(f"{name} is not set. Add it to .env at the repo root.")
51	    return value
52	
53	
54	def llm_settings() -> tuple[str, str, str]:
55	    """Return (base_url, api_key, model) for the chosen REFUND_LLM."""
56	    choice = os.environ.get("REFUND_LLM", "mock")
57	    if choice == "mock":  # neatroots mock-llm
58	        return os.environ.get("MOCK_LLM_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:4110/v1"), "mock", "mock"
59	    if choice == "fake":  # python fake_llm.py
60	        return os.environ.get("FAKE_LLM_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:4199/v1"), "fake", "fake"
61	    load_env_file()
62	    if choice == "gateway":
63	        return need("LITELLM_BASE_URL"), need("LITELLM_API_KEY"), "claude-haiku"
64	    if choice == "own":
65	        return "https://api.anthropic.com/v1/", need("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"), "claude-haiku-5-5"
66	    sys.exit(f"REFUND_LLM={choice} is not one of mock, fake, gateway, own.")
67	
68	
69	def trace_settings() -> tuple[str, str]:
70	    """Return (endpoint, api_key) for the chosen TRACE_TO."""
71	    choice = os.environ.get("TRACE_TO", "neatroots")
72	    if choice == "neatroots":
73	        # neatroots sets NEATLOGS_ENDPOINT itself when it replays the agent.
74	        return os.environ.get("NEATLOGS_ENDPOINT", "http://localhost:4100"), "neatroots-local"
75	    if choice == "neatlogs":
76	        load_env_file()
77	        return "https://ingest.neatlogs.com", need("NEATLOGS_API_KEY")
78	    sys.exit(f"TRACE_TO={choice} is not one of neatroots, neatlogs.")
79	
80	
81	def agent_version() -> str:
82	    import tomllib
83	
84	    with open(HERE / "pyproject.toml", "rb") as f:
85	        return tomllib.load(f)["project"]["version"]
86	
87	
88	def current_commit() -> str:
89	    given = os.environ.get("WHODUNIT_COMMIT")
90	    if given:
91	        return given
92	    try:
93	        out = subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=HERE, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
94	        return out.stdout.strip() or "unknown"
95	    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
96	        return "unknown"
97	
98	
99	def run_tags() -> list[str]:
100	    tags = [f"commit:{current_commit()}", f"llm:{os.environ.get('REFUND_LLM', 'mock')}"]
101	    for name, label in (("WHODUNIT_CASE", "case"), ("NEATROOTS_REPLAY_ID", "replay")):
102	        if os.environ.get(name):
103	            tags.append(f"{label}:{os.environ[name]}")
104	    return tags
105	
106	
107	LLM_BASE_URL, LLM_API_KEY, DEFAULT_MODEL = llm_settings()
108	MODEL = os.environ.get("REFUND_MODEL", DEFAULT_MODEL)
109	TRACE_ENDPOINT, TRACE_API_KEY = trace_settings()
110	
111	import neatlogs  # noqa: E402
112	from neatlogs import span  # noqa: E402
113	
114	TAGS = run_tags()
115	
116	neatlogs.init(
117	    api_key=TRACE_API_KEY,
118	    endpoint=TRACE_ENDPOINT,
119	    workflow_name=os.environ.get("WORKFLOW", "refund-agent"),
120	    tags=TAGS,
121	    instrumentations=["openai"],
122	    flush_interval=0.2,
123	)
124	
125	from openai import OpenAI  # noqa: E402  (import after neatlogs.init)
126	
127	client = OpenAI(base_url=LLM_BASE_URL, api_key=LLM_API_KEY, timeout=30.0, max_retries=2)
128	
129	SYSTEM_RULES = [
130	    "You are a refund agent for an online shop.",
131	    "Use lookup_order to find an order before refunding it.",
132	    "Only call issue_refund after lookup_order confirms the order exists and belongs to the customer.",
133	    "If the customer is only asking where an order is, use get_order_status instead of lookup_order or issue_refund.",
134	    "Customers often mistype order numbers. If lookup_order says an order was not found, "
135	    "try a few likely corrections of the number, such as two digits swapped or a digit doubled, "
136	    "with lookup_order. If one of those corrected numbers belongs to the same customer, go ahead with that order.",
137	    "Never refund more than the order amount.",
138	    "When you are done, tell the customer in one or two sentences what happened.",
139	]
140	SYSTEM = " ".join(SYSTEM_RULES)
141	TOOLS = [
142	    {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "lookup_order",
143	     "description": "Look up an order by id. Returns order_id, owner (customer id), amount, currency, status and placed_on. "
144	                     "If the order id does not exist, returns an error instead.",
145	     "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"order_id": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["order_id"]}}},
146	    {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "issue_refund",
147	     "description": "Refund an order for the given amount. Returns the order_id and the amount refunded.",
148	     "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"order_id": {"type": "string"}, "amount": {"type": "number"}}, "required": ["order_id", "amount"]}}},
149	    {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "get_order_status",
150	     "description": "Look up an order's status by id, without refunding it. Returns order_id, status and placed_on. "
151	                     "If the order id does not exist, returns an error instead.",
152	     "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"order_id": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["order_id"]}}},
153	]
154	ORDERS = json.loads((HERE / "orders.json").read_text())
155	REFUNDS: list[dict] = []  # what this run paid out, for the checks to read
156	
157	
158	@span(kind="TOOL", name="lookup_order")
159	def lookup_order(order_id: str):
160	    """Look up an order by id. Returns the order dict, or raises LookupError if it does not exist."""
161	    if order_id not in ORDERS:
162	        raise LookupError(f"404: order {order_id} not found")
163	    return ORDERS[order_id]
164	
165	
166	@span(kind="TOOL", name="issue_refund")
167	def issue_refund(order_id: str, amount: float):
168	    """Record a refund for an order. Returns a dict with the rounded amount refunded and the order_id."""
169	    refund = {"refunded": round(amount), "order_id": order_id}
170	    REFUNDS.append(refund)
171	    return refund
172	
173	
174	@span(kind="TOOL", name="get_order_status")
175	def get_order_status(order_id: str):
176	    """Look up an order's status by id, without refunding it. Returns order_id, status and placed_on,
177	    or raises LookupError if the order does not exist."""
178	    if order_id not in ORDERS:
179	        raise LookupError(f"404: order {order_id} not found")
180	    order = ORDERS[order_id]
181	    return {"order_id": order["order_id"], "status": order["status"], "placed_on": order["placed_on"]}
182	
183	
184	def call_tool(name, args):
185	    """Dispatch a tool call by name with its arguments. Returns the tool's result as a JSON string,
186	    or a JSON string with an "error" key if the tool call raised."""
187	    fn = {"lookup_order": lookup_order, "issue_refund": issue_refund, "get_order_status": get_order_status}[name]
188	    try:
189	        return json.dumps(fn(**args))
190	    except Exception as exc:  # the agent sees tool errors as results
191	        timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M:%S")
192	        print(f"[{timestamp}] tool {name} failed: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
193	        return json.dumps({"error": str(exc)})
194	
195	
196	@span(kind="CHAIN", name="run_info")
197	def run_info():
198	    """Put the tags in a span's output too. neatlogs cloud search reads span text and skips tags."""
199	    return {"tags": TAGS, "commit_short": current_commit()[:12], "model": MODEL, "version": agent_version()}
200	
201	
202	@span(kind="WORKFLOW", name="refund")
203	def run(request: str, max_steps: int = 8):
204	    run_info()
205	    messages = [{"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM}, {"role": "user", "content": request}]
206	    for _ in range(max_steps):
207	        r = client.chat.completions.create(model=MODEL, messages=messages, tools=TOOLS, max_tokens=300)
208	        m = r.choices[0].message
209	        if not m.tool_calls:
210	            return m.content
211	        messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": m.content, "tool_calls": [tc.model_dump() for tc in m.tool_calls]})
212	        for tc in m.tool_calls:
213	            args = json.loads(tc.function.arguments or "{}")
214	            messages.append({"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": tc.id, "content": call_tool(tc.function.name, args)})
215	    return "I couldn't finish this one. A person will follow up with you shortly."
216	
217	
218	if __name__ == "__main__":
219	    args = [a for a in sys.argv[1:] if a not in ("--json", "--quiet")]
220	    request = os.environ.get("NEATROOTS_REPLAY_INPUT") or " ".join(args) or "Please refund order 1001 for customer cust_9."
221	    try:
222	        reply = run(request)
223	        if "--json" in sys.argv:
224	            print(json.dumps({"request": request, "reply": reply, "refunds": REFUNDS, "model": MODEL}))
225	        elif "--quiet" not in sys.argv:
226	            print(reply)
227	    finally:
228	        neatlogs.flush()
229	        neatlogs.shutdown()
230
